metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia appear greener on February 7, 2021 as compared to the same region on January 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing vegetation greenness between two specific dates (Feb 7, 2021 vs Jan 29, 2020) around Windhoek, Namibia. 1. **Search strategy**: - Location: Windhoek, Namibia (need to create a geometry around it) - Dates: Feb 7, 2021 and Jan 29, 2020 - Collection: Sentinel-2 is good for vegetation monitoring with good resolution - Need to calculate NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) to measure greenness 2. **Masking strategy**: - Should mask clouds for both dates to get clean vegetation data - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. **Logic**: - Calculate mean NDVI for both dates - Compare if 2021 NDVI > 2020 NDVI - Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels Let me structure this: - Create a point for Windhoek and buffer it to create a region - Get Sentinel-2 images for both dates with cloud masking - Calculate NDVI for both - Compare mean NDVI values - Handle cases where collections are empty or no valid pixels ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.0832, -22.5700]); // Windhoek coordinates const region = windhoek.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Windhoek // Define the two comparison dates const date2020 = '2020-01-29'; const date2021 = '2021-02-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 with cloud masking function getS2Image(date) { const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); // Apply cloud masking function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const maskedCollection = collection.map(maskClouds); return maskedCollection.median().clip(region); } // Get images for both dates const img2020 = getS2Image(date2020); const img2021 = getS2Image(date2021); // Check if collections are empty const count2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2020-01-29', '2020-01-30') .size(); const count2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2021-02-07', '2021-02-08') .size(); const count2020Info = count2020.getInfo(); const count2021Info = count2021.getInfo(); print(`2020-01-29 Images: ${count2020Info}`); print(`2021-02-07 Images: ${count2021Info}`); if (count2020Info === 0 || count2021Info === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Calculate NDVI function calculateNDVI(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } const ndvi2020 = calculateNDVI(img2020); const ndvi2021 = calculateNDVI(img2021); // Get pixel counts and mean NDVI const stats2020 = ndvi2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2020 = stats2020.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const count2020px = stats2020.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const mean2021 = stats2021.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const count2021px = stats2021.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); print(`2020 NDVI: ${mean2020?.toFixed(4) || 'null'}, Pixels: ${count2020px}`); print(`2021 NDVI: ${mean2021?.toFixed(4) || 'null'}, Pixels: ${count2021px}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count2020px === 0 || count2021px === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (mean2020 === null || mean2021 === null || isNaN(mean2020) || isNaN(mean2021) || mean2020 > 1 || mean2021 > 1 || mean2020 < -1 || mean2021 < -1) { print("C3"); return; } // Final comparison if (mean2021 > mean2020) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
